name: Percipio
summary: Percipio supplies industrial 3D cameras and machine-vision software for industrial automation, logistics and mobile robotics. Its camera range covers time-of-flight, dot-pattern structured light and fringe-pattern structured light. The company also develops RVS Machine Vision Software for industrial automation applications. Its official company profile identifies Shanghai as its headquarters.
